lines.speaker: Super Perfect Cell
lines.text: Aw, shit! That was meant for Tien!

lines.speaker: Super Perfect Cell
lines.text: It's just so hard to parse your power levels anymore. You're all so weak!

lines.speaker: Super Perfect Cell
lines.text: But I see those shocked expressions of yours... Brains wracking over how I'm back, and *better* than ever!

lines.speaker: Super Perfect Cell
lines.text: And it all lies within my body.

lines.speaker: Super Perfect Cell
lines.text: A nucleus ever so small but *frighteningly* powerful.

lines.speaker: Super Perfect Cell
lines.text: And lucky me, it survived my little kamikaze.

lines.speaker: Super Perfect Cell
lines.text: But the most important part is, my inherited Saiyan biology --thanks, Dads-- gave me a boost in my power, returning me not only to my perfect form, but a form even *greater* than before!

lines.speaker: Super Perfect Cell
lines.text: Okay. Yamcha, accurate, but tone it down.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Hey Gohan, if you're knock him in the gut again, you think he'll pop out a second Eighteen?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: I'm not even mad you're still alive. I've got some shit to work through...

lines.speaker: Super Perfect Cell
lines.text: Aww, is the cat in the cradle?

lines.speaker: Super Perfect Cell
lines.text: Here, let me put you in a grave.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Trunks! Don't worry, buddy! I've been where you are.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: We're gonna get you a Senzu bean and--

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: I've been there too, I guess.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Although, honestly, the afterlife part isn't too bad.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: The whole *dying* part of it is...

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: (ringing intensifies) Everything just kind of slows down and you feel yourself slip the mortal coil...

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: ...to this day, I still wonder if I've ever been brought back or if I'm still in the process of dying, you know?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Oh my God, someone finally put it into words!

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Is it any easier the second time?

lines.speaker: Super Perfect Cell
lines.text: And when you get to Hell... tell them to make some room.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: As... long as I'm still breathing... you won't kill anyone else.

lines.speaker: Super Perfect Cell
lines.text: No prob, I can free up five minutes... or however long it takes to charge *this*.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Uh, you know how we only had eight beans, right?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: And how many people are here?

lines.speaker: Super Perfect Cell
lines.text: I want you to know this blast isn't just meant for you, Gohan.

lines.speaker: Super Perfect Cell
lines.text: It goes out to the entire world!

lines.speaker: Super Perfect Cell
lines.text: My swan song to this planet!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Trunks could have been brought back, no problem!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: But no, you picked *now* to be a parent!?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Oh, well look at me, I'm no better.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Now I'm monoplegic and Cell's gonna kill us all!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Well, if this is it, then....

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Hey, Tien... Since this is the end--

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: If you're about to say "I love you", I swear to God...

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Actually, I was gonna say you're the biggest asshole I know.

lines.speaker: Super Perfect Cell
lines.text: Honestly, Gohan, the maraschino cherry on top of all of this --besides rending *you* from existence-- is that because I am not burdened by the evolutionary failure of aging, I will live *forever*!

lines.speaker: Super Perfect Cell
lines.text: Gonna have to pick up a hobby, though...

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: So this is how I die...

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Down an arm and killed by an android.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Why does this feel oddly familiar?

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Your father wouldn't sit there and take it, and neither should you!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: You want to do right by Goku?

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Then don't let that bastard scare you!

lines.speaker: Super Perfect Cell
lines.text: He's right, brat! It's just like you told me: "There's no point in being afraid of the inevitable."

lines.speaker: Super Perfect Cell
lines.text: Magnificent! One last stand against me!

lines.speaker: Super Perfect Cell
lines.text: Give me what your daddy couldn't, before I send ya home to him!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: (Voice Crack) It's a *real* good thing beams don't just explode on impact with each other.
Captioner's note: These next few minutes are bright and flashy. If you're prone to epileptic seizures, take care.

lines.speaker: Super Perfect Cell
lines.text: Tell me when that arm starts feeling numb, *brat*!

lines.speaker: Super Perfect Cell
lines.text: Worst case scenario - you die and get stronger!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Is it too much to ask that you just shut up and fight!?

lines.speaker: Super Perfect Cell
lines.text: What's that, brat? I can't hear you!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: If someone with one arm speaks with sign language, is that a speech impediment or an accent?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: 'Dammit! my legs feel like they're about to give out, I can't feel my arm, And nobody's SHUTTING THE HELL UP!'

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: [telepathically] Oh, sorry, I-I'll come back later.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Sorry it took me so long to call. King Yemma's line was the *worst*!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I literally thought I'd skipped it and went straight to Hell.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: [t] Also, the phone won't stop yelling at me.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: I don't think I can do this!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: He's so much stronger and... and it's all my fault!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: It was my cowardice... then my hubris... and now my weakness!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I wanna tell you - that if you don't do this...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: [t] See? I'm not even close to that strong! ...Yet.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: You're more than just my son.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Now, plant your feet... grit your teeth... and EAT! THAT! *HORSE*!!!

lines.speaker: Super Perfect Cell
lines.text: Your second wind or your dying gasp?!

lines.speaker: Super Perfect Cell
lines.text: Though you have fought alone, you will not *die* alone.

lines.speaker: Super Perfect Cell
lines.text: That is my last gift to you!
Frank Sinatra - "My Way", sung by Takahata101 as Cell

lines.speaker: Super Perfect Cell
lines.text: ♫ My friend, I'll say it clear ♫

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Nobody's gonna hold it against me if I start crying, are they?

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Better now than five minutes ago.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: So, buddy! You beat your first bad guy! How's it feel?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: My autonomic nervous system shut down all non-critical bodily functions.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: I cannot move, hear, or see.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: I really, really need to use the bathroom.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Yeah, let's get you to the Lookout, little buddy.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: So, is there any food on the Lookout? 'Cause I'm starving.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Yeah, yeah. Don't eat his stuff.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Hey, Piccolo! We're gonna stop for snacks on the way!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: I'm surprised you're not taking credit for the win.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: I'm surprised you're not thanking me for saving your worthless lives.

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: I need to rethink my life.

lines.speaker: Jimmy Firecracker
lines.text: Mr. Satan! We found some working equipment in the van!

lines.speaker: Jimmy Firecracker
lines.text: We've only got audio, but the people can hear you!

lines.speaker: Jimmy Firecracker
lines.text: Would you like to tell the world what just happened?!

lines.speaker: Jimmy Firecracker
lines.text: Would you like to tell the world, including your millions of *scared, confused* and apparently *rioting* fans...

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: Jimmy... and all you at home...

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: And I am the one who TOOK HIM *DOWN*!!

lines.speaker: Jimmy Firecracker
lines.text: Is there a body, Mr. Satan?

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: D'ah, a-uh, I mean, OF COURSE NOT!!!

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: He exploded without a trace, on impact, Jimmy.

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: That's why it's called Mr. Satan's Megaton Punch!

lines.speaker: Mr. Satan
lines.text: But if he weren't such a *chump*, I'd have given him a punch for all my wonderful Satanists out there!

lines.speaker: Guardsman
lines.text: Well, King Furry, it seems that we were victorious today.

lines.speaker: Guardsman
lines.text: Yes, sir. I do believe it was the son of that Goku fellow.

lines.speaker: Guardsman
lines.text: Unfortunately, the world may never know the truth.

lines.speaker: Guardsman
lines.text: We'll go for walkies later, sir.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Nothing! We just let him fight Cell!

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Well yeah, that's just [sotto voce] kinda how we do things...

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Just give him to me, you mook!

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: I don't think the healing is working.

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Hey... Sorry about your dad, kid.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: You guys, it's fine! He's dead.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: There's a lot to unpack there.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: You did a good job out there, kid.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Without you, we'd all be dead.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: I... I just wanted you to know that.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Okay, so why did you bring two dead chicks to my lookout?

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Where am I? What happened? WHERE'S CELL?

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: On the Lookout; Gohan killed Cell; and... Gohan killed Cell.

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Okay. Wow, you're throwing a lot at me here.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Also, I'm in love with you.

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Suddenly, I'm elated that Trunks is dead.

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: What? So he didn't have to see *that*.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Okay, Shenron. Wakey wakey, eggs and dead people...

lines.speaker: Shenron
lines.text: STATE YOUR WISHES AND I SHALL GRANT THEM.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: He seems... less moody than usual.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Eternal Dragon, our first wish is to bring back everyone on Earth killed by Cell.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: I get it, it's a beautiful desk. Can I just go to Heave--?

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Alright, since you resurrected more than one person, you only have one wish left.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Yeah, shouldn't Goku be back now?

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: You wanna tell them or should I?

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: I *was* going to save this for after Krillin died.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: But since you apparently did the impossible...

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: ...you still can't bring back someone who's already died before.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Don't freak out. *Porunga* can still bring back people who have died.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Good thinking, Piccolo! We'll just use the remaining wish to go to Namek!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: [t] You want to tell 'em or should I?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: [t] Hey guys! I'm in Heaven with King Kai!

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: [t] Yeah, thanks for specifying "on Earth", by the way!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: [t] Okay, Goku! We're gonna go to Namek and wish you back, so just sit tight, buddy!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: [t] I gave it some thought, and... well...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Raditz and Vegeta came to Earth because of me right?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: And then Freezer came to Earth because of me...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: And the Androids were *made* because of me...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: It just feels like every time the Earth's in danger, I'm the common dominator.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: And frankly, I'm tired of dominating.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: [t] Everything you just said was *technically* correct.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I'm just thinking, maybe... it would be *better*... if I stay dead.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: [t] But... you've been a part of our lives for so long.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: It can't just... end like this, right?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: [t] I know it's hard, guys, but I think it's for the best.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: And this doesn't *have* to be goodbye forever.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Maybe one day when the time is right, I'll come back to see you again.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Because you were right about one thing.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: I can take care of us.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Just... Promise you'll call every once in a while.

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: [t] I AM NOT YOUR CELL PHONE!!!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: [t] Whoops, I gotta go here. Getting some interference.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: And say "hi" to your little brother for me.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Eh, now, where's the off button...?

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Sooo, if, uh, you guys don't have any wishes... I've never really gotten the chance to--

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Could you turn Seventeen and Eighteen back into normal humans?

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Oh, no, it's cool. Next time, though?

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Oh, I get it. Turn them back into humans and make them weaker.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Dr. Gero stole their lives away from them.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: I just think they deserve a better life.

lines.speaker: Shenron
lines.text: THAT WISH IS BEYOND MY POWER.

lines.speaker: Shenron
lines.text: LOOK, I DON'T MAKE THE RULES.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Because they are incredibly fair and balanced.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Honestly, man? I don't see the downside to being an Android.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: You know, except walking around with a *nuke* in your chest.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Wait, Shenron! Can you take the bombs out of them?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: For the record, I agree with the results of your wish, but not the motive.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: I just... want to do the right thing, okay?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Thanks. Too bad Android 18 will never know.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: I wish I had one more chance to talk to her.

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Okay, what the hell was that?!

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: You could have wished for a billion zeni.

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: But instead you used a magical wish-granting dragon... For us.

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Okay, look. I've got to go find my brother.

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: I can only imagine what's going through *his* head right now...

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: I never did get that boat.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Guess I flew into that one.

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: I told Chiaotzu if I wasn't dead by the end of the day that we'd eat out.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Thank you for all of your help, Mr. Tien Shinhan.

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: You're the one who picked up our slack, kid.

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Now keep that bright head in the clouds, and strong feet on the ground.

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Which will probably be when the world's in danger, so just... keep a close eye on Vegeta.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Can any of you get a read on that guy?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: We should probably follow his lead.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Namek has shorter days than this has been.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Are you going to stay here on the Lookout, Mr. Piccolo?

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: I mean, that's up to Dende.

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Are you gonna visit us, Gohan?

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Then yes, we have a room for you, Nail.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: I've never had a room before!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: If you guys wouldn't mind, I'd like if you could come by Capsule Corp tomorrow, before I leave.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Before I'd met you guys, all I had was stories.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: And now that I've fought alongside you all, I'm.. I'm gonna miss you.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: We'll be there with bells on.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: And I'll see you later, Dende!

lines.speaker: Dende
lines.text: Visit soon Gohan! We'll have a slumber party, we could play Spin the Bottle!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: No, sorry. There's only room in the Time Machine for one person.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Can't you, like... put me in a capsule?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Why would you want to go back to my post-apocalyptic future?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: ...Is it because my mom is single?

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Oh, hey, my apartment's this way, later Trunks!

lines.speaker: Chi Chi
lines.text: Your father would rather be dead than live with his wife and children!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Dad might be... well, *is* one of the dumbest, most selfish, most irresponsible people we know...

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: But... Before he died, he mentioned us. All of us.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Granddad, seriously? Could you not, right now?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: 'Bout as sure as I can be.

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: Most men would die all over again just to get back what you had.

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: A loving wife, two sons, unearthly powers...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Yeah, but those aren't going anywhere.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: And if they do, they'll probably just be back to me.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I'm just... not afraid of change, I guess.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: When it comes down to it, I *know* they're gonna be alright.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Because if I've learned *anything* since landing on Earth...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: ...It's that everyone is stronger than they think they are.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I left behind the best people in the *world*, and I'm *happy* about that.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Things changed and they're gonna *keep* changing.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Now, they can live their *own* lives and make their *own* futures.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: An' I can't *wait* to see the kind of future they make.
♪ Unmei No Hi ~ Tamashii tai Tamashii, instrumental ♪ (Day of Fate ~ Spirit vs Spirit)

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: I'm surprised you knew I'd be here.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: What can I do you for?

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: I made a promise to myself, and I'm here to keep it.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: O-okay! But, um, j-j-just a heads up. I'm a grower.
♪ Music box playing a soothing version of Unmei no Hi ~ Tamashii tai Tamashii ♪
(Thank you, TeamFourStar, for all your hard work to entertain us. You truly are the greatest!)

segments.title: Perfect-er Cell
segments.quote: I... am now...! / Perfect-er Cell! / Okay. Yamcha, accurate, but tone it down.

segments.title: The Biggest Asshole I Know
segments.quote: Actually, I was gonna say you're the biggest asshole I know. / You're also my best friend.

segments.title: EAT! THAT! HORSE!
segments.quote: You're better than *him*! You're better than *me*! ... Now, plant your feet... grit your teeth... and EAT! THAT! *HORSE*!!!

segments.title: Cell Sings My Way
segments.quote: ♫ And now, the end is near... I did it my way ♫ (Frank Sinatra's "My Way", sung by Cell as he dies)

segments.title: Horse... Eaten!
segments.quote: Horse... eaten! / Somebody catch meeeeeeee... / Cell is dead!

segments.title: I Am the One Who TOOK HIM DOWN
segments.quote: Cell is dead. And I am the one who TOOK HIM *DOWN*!! / Hail Satan! Hail Satan!

segments.title: Aaand That's My Limit
segments.quote: Also, I'm in love with you. / Aaand that's my limit! Thank you. Bye.

segments.title: Tired of Dominating
segments.quote: I'm the common dominator. And frankly, I'm tired of dominating. It's *your* turn to dominate, Gohan.

segments.title: Guess I Flew Into That One
segments.quote: W-w-what's your number? / 18! / Heh! Guess I flew into that one.
